blocking_findings.title: Change-id derivation admitted openspec/changes/archive/
blocking_findings.summary: R6-N1 excluded archive/ from UNION mode but the exclusion was never propagated to the DERIVATION rule one paragraph below, which round 6 had just rewritten. Verified on three real archive commits: with rename detection a chore(openspec): archive PR derives the literal id 'archive' (count 1, blocking run against a dir with no specs/); with --no-renames it derives 2-3 ids and hard-reds every archive PR. Fixed by excluding archive/ from derivation, mandating --no-renames so the result cannot depend on a similarity heuristic, and adding scenario archive-pull-requests-skip.
